items.title: Egyptian journalist faces terrorism charges after entire newsroom detained

sentences.en: Egyptian journalist faces terrorism charges after entire newsroom detained.
sentences.zh: 埃及记者在整个新闻编辑室被拘留后面临恐怖主义指控。

sentences.en: Calls for release of six Matsadaash staff after one is charged, while whereabouts of other five remain unknown An Egyptian journalist has been charged with joining a terrorist group, days after an entire newsroom was detained in what rights groups have said is a crackdown on press freedoms.
sentences.zh: 一人被起诉后呼吁释放六名Matsadaash工作人员，而其他五人的下落不明一名埃及记者被指控加入恐怖组织，几天前，整个新闻编辑室被拘留，人权组织称这是对新闻自由的镇压。

sentences.en: Last week, authorities arrested six journalists from the independent fact-checking and investigative platform Matsadaash – literally meaning “don’t believe” – accusing them in a statement of being unlicensed and publishing false news on behalf of the outlawed Muslim Brotherhood.
sentences.zh: 上周，当局从独立的事实核查和调查平台Matsadaash逮捕了六名记者–字面意思是“不相信” –在一份声明中指控他们未经许可并代表被取缔的穆斯林兄弟会发布虚假新闻。

items.title: Australia and Turkey criticised for hosting UN climate conference while embracing coal

sentences.en: Australia and Turkey criticised for hosting UN climate conference while embracing coal.
sentences.zh: 澳大利亚和土耳其批评在主办联合国气候大会的同时拥抱煤炭。

sentences.en: Global campaign group 350.org urges Cop31 hosts to announce a coal phase-out date and national roadmaps to get off fossil fuels Sign up for climate and environment editor Adam Morton’s free Clear Air newsletter here The hosts of the next major United Nations climate conference, Turkey and Australia, are facing criticism for being partners in a coal supply chain while remaining near silent on the need for a global deal to rapidly get off fossil fuels.
sentences.zh: 全球运动组织350.org敦促COP31东道主宣布煤炭淘汰日期和摆脱化石燃料的国家路线图在此处注册气候与环境编辑亚当·莫顿（ Adam Morton ）的免费《清新空气》（ Clear Air ）通讯下一届联合国主要气候会议的东道主土耳其和澳大利亚因成为煤炭供应链的合作伙伴而受到批评，同时对快速摆脱化石燃料的全球协议的需求保持沉默。

sentences.en: With the Cop31 summit in the Turkish Mediterranean city of Antalya just a month away, the two countries running the fortnight-long talks have been accused by activists of a “vacuum of action” on plans for a transition away from coal, gas and oil – a key goal of many nations at the talks.
sentences.zh: 距离在土耳其地中海城市安塔利亚举行的COP31峰会仅一个月，两国举行了长达两周的会谈，活动人士指责这两个国家在远离煤炭、天然气和石油的计划上存在“行动真空” --这是许多国家在会谈中的关键目标。

sentences.en: Sign up to get climate and environment editor Adam Morton’s Clear Air column as a free newsletter Continue reading..
sentences.zh: 注册获取气候与环境编辑Adam Morton的Clear Air专栏，作为免费时事通讯继续阅读。

items.title: Would slashing migration tank the economy or reset Australia’s living standards? Canada may offer clues

sentences.en: Canada may offer clues.

sentences.en: Annual population growth for the North American nation has slowed to just 0.5% – and the economy is ‘adjusting’ Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Would slashing net overseas migration “trash the economy” or deliver the necessary population “reset” to restore Australia’s stagnant living standards?

sentences.en: Labor and an ascendant One Nation have presented starkly different visions of what a migration program in the national interest looks like.

items.title: Polls close in first round of Brazil’s high-stakes presidential election

sentences.zh: 在巴西高风险总统选举的第一轮选举中，民意调查接近尾声。

sentences.en: Leftwing incumbent Lula trying to fight off close rival Flávio Bolsonaro, far-right son of jailed ex-president The polls have closed in the first round of Brazil’s highly polarised and high-stakes presidential election that could change not only the direction of Latin America’s largest country but that of the entire region.
sentences.zh: 左翼现任总统卢拉试图击败被监禁的前总统的极右儿子弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗（ Flávio Bolsonaro ）在巴西高度两极分化和高风险的总统选举的第一轮选举中，民意调查已经结束，这不仅可能改变拉丁美洲最大国家的方向，还可能改变整个地区的方向。

sentences.en: The election pits the leftwing president, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, who is seeking a fourth non-consecutive term, against the far-right senator Flávio Bolsonaro, an ally of Donald Trump and the son of the former president Jair Bolsonaro, who is serving a 27-year sentence for attempting a coup after his failed 2022 re-election attempt.
sentences.zh: 这次选举让正在寻求第四个非连续任期的左翼总统路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦（ Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva ）与极右翼参议员弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗（ Flávio Bolsonaro ）对抗，后者是唐纳德·特朗普的盟友，也是前总统贾尔·博尔索纳罗（ Jair Bolsonaro ）的儿子，后者因在2022年连任失败后试图发动政变而被判处27年徒刑。

sentences.en: Right after the Soviet Union launched Sputnik in 1957, UNOOSA, the UN Office for Outer Space Affairs, was established and has since been monitoring developments across more than 77 successful lunar missions and other journeys while also taking a lead role in the annual World Space Week, which runs from 4 to 10 October.
sentences.zh: 在苏联于1957年发射人造卫星后不久，联合国外层空间事务厅（ UNOOSA ）成立，此后一直在监测超过77次成功的月球任务和其他旅行的发展，同时还在10月4日至10日举行的年度世界空间周中发挥主导作用。

sentences.en: Britain under pressure to put tariffs on cheap Chinese vehicle imports ahead of protectionist trade measures Britain’s car industry is grappling with a “difficult trade-off” between China and Europe, as manufacturers struggle to balance the benefits of both markets ahead of looming trade measures that could restrict UK exports to the EU.
sentences.zh: 在英国采取保护主义贸易措施之前，英国面临着对廉价中国汽车进口征收关税的压力，英国汽车行业正在努力应对中国和欧洲之间的“艰难权衡” ，因为制造商在迫在眉睫的贸易措施之前努力平衡两个市场的好处，这些措施可能会限制英国对欧盟的出口。

sentences.en: The UK is an outlier in choosing not to put import taxes on Chinese vehicles, even as the US has shut them out almost entirely , and the EU imposes duties of up to 45% .
sentences.zh: 英国是选择不对中国汽车征收进口税的例外，尽管美国几乎完全将其拒之门外，而欧盟则征收高达45%的关税。
